data.name: ASUKA x Redline Reverie
data.detailed_description:
Step into the Thrilling World of Asuka

In this adrenaline-fueled racing game, you follow Asuka Sakai, a spirited student from a picturesque Japanese farming village with a passion for street racing. Inspired by her father's legendary racing past, she dives into the world of speed, rebellion, and rivalry at GRACE Academy — a prestigious school for talented girl racers.

With a natural talent for tuning cars and an unyielding drive to challenge any opponent, Asuka rises as a notorious racer, admired and feared in equal measure.

--------------------------------------------

A Fusion of Old and New

This game blends a casual, stylized aesthetic with detailed physics, immersing players in a rich atmosphere filled with captivating characters and storylines inspired by the charm of classic-era games and Japanese manga.

Diverse JDM Cars and Customization

Choose from over 50 unique JDM-inspired cars, and up to 100 variants with extensive customization options available. Fine-tune engines, transmissions, suspensions, exhausts, and tweak advanced settings like camshaft timings and even tire pressure. Use a dedicated dynamometer to analyze power, torque curves, and air-fuel ratios, ensuring your car performs at its peak.

Iconic Japanese Locations

Race through stylized recreations of Japan’s countryside on long (6–10 km) and short (1–2 km) courses. Weather and time-of-day variations affect handling, demanding strategic adaptations.

Authentic Gameplay Experience

Step into Asuka’s life, from the local internet café filled with racing tales to the local mechanic for installations and tune-ups. Order parts online, manage your racing pursuits, and stay immersed in the world without constant menu navigation.

Immersive Game Atmosphere

The proprietary physics model built solely for this game authentically recreates the clunky, weighted feel of classic JDM sports cars. It incorporates realistic mechanics like torque curves, aerodynamics, slip dynamics, and even tire deformation. Combined with custom-branded cars, parts, and racing teams, the game offers a seamless, immersive experience that brings Asuka’s story and the racing world to life.

ASUKA is an arcade racing game and a work of fiction. All vehicles, tracks, and environments depicted in the game are fictionalized and not intended to accurately represent any real-world entities or inspirations.

NOTE:

"ASUKA x Redline Reverie" is a work in progress by two developer built for Windows PC as an offline single-player game only, supporting controllers and wheels .

data.short_description: Enter Asuka’s world of intense street races across Japan’s iconic mountains. Tune and personalize JDM cars as you face fierce rivals, uncover secrets, and forge alliances. Follow a manga-inspired story filled with mystery where nothing is as it seems, until the very end.
data.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America
